<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex113052024-10-1516-25-22" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> 
               <milestone n="Colophon (86a4-86a6)" unit="section"/>
              <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5482"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi <abbr>pha rol</abbr> du phyin <abbr>pa'i</abbr> man <abbr>ngag gi</abbr> <abbr>bstan bcos</abbr> mngon par <abbr>rtogs</abbr> pa'i rgyan</rs> ces bya ba'i 'grel pa</rs>'i bshad pa slob ma la phan pa</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ¦ nang rig <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>bstan bcos</abbr> sde snod 3 la mkhas shing | sgra dang <lb n="86a5"/> tshad ma dang snyan dngags dang sdebs sbyor <abbr>lasog</abbr> pa tha snyad kyi gtsug rnaMs phal cher shes pas gsung rab kyi tshig don la mi 'jig pa'i spobs pa can ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5964">shar dags po'i lo ts+tsha ba sar+bha j+nya mi tra</rs>s | sa mo glang gi lo gro zhun zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5765">chos gra chen po dpal gyi rtses thang</rs> <lb n="86a6"/> du rdzog par bris pa'o || || maMga la b+ha wa tu || ||</seg></TEI>
